name: signal-stack
vibe: A film-title-card template for launches that want to sound inevitable. Most beats sit on chromatic near-blacks — #05070E void and #121A2B carbon — where full-bleed screenshots go under a heavy scrim, so a low-res capture reads as atmosphere rather than evidence. Then the statement beat inverts: the frame floods with the lead accent #A3E635 and black type, one hard colour cut in the middle of the dark. That accent is mid-lightness and high-chroma rather than neon, so when the palette rotates onto a brand hue the plate is painted in the real colour — and painted big: statement ground, kicker pill, block CTA button, tile rules, lead counter. Oversized Anton caps stack hard left with Barlow Semi Condensed beside them at 92–124, and the CTA copy starts high at 240 so a long headline can wrap to three lines and still leave the button inside the 1080 frame. Azure #4C82F0 takes secondary chips, the feature glow and the third counter. The world is only a slow paper beam raking at −22° and two low glow blooms, accent low-left, azure high-right — never still, never fighting the type. Cameras commit to single big gestures: a long zoom in, then a wide push across, so one usable photograph carries a scene. Stats cuts imagery away to a hard #000208 frame with white and accent numerals. Built for AI, fintech and developer-tool teams with no footage budget.

assets.photoMod: Push everything toward near-silhouette: crushed blacks, single hard key light, one cool or acid rim, no mid-grey mush. Shallow depth of field, high contrast, desaturated except for one glowing hue. Screenshots should be dimmed 60-75% and cropped into detail rather than shown whole.

laptop glow in a black room
